text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—All riiight, time for grub, time for grub!
I've been lookin' forward to this all morning~♪
choice_data_list: You're in a good mood today, huh
You're in a good mood today, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, truth is, I helped out here the other day
and got a ticket for a special menu item.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, there are two of those menus.
And it seems you can trade this in for whichever one you like."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, in short, it's ultra rare!
I'm looking forward to seeing what it's like!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Umm, special menu, special menu... Ah!
It was written right in the corner!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Umm, one of them is...
'Angel Lovelyâ'...
and, 'Heart... Squishy Pudding'...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
W-What's with this super embarrassing name?!
I mean, sure, it sounds delicious, maybe... but still!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What about the other one then!?
..."Ultra-Spicy Tartarus Lava Curry"!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: T-This looks crazy spicy, man...! Plus, it says at the bottom: 'Fewer than five people have ever finished it'... Whoa, seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The name sounds cool, and 'fewer than five fingers' has a nice ring to it, but... so it's that tough, huh...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the other one is, um,
'A-Angel... Love'...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, whoaaaaa!!
Which one am I supposed to choose!?
choice_data_list: Let's push past this hellish spice!
In life, a little sweetness matters too, you know.
In life, a little sweetness matters too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, whoaaaaa!!
Which one am I supposed to choose!?
choice_data_list: Let's push past this hellish spice!
In life, a little sweetness matters too, you know.
In life, a little sweetness matters too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa?! S-Seriously...?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...N-No! I'm not scared!
I'm totally not scared at all!
Alright, let's do this!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Vodka bravely took on
the ultra-spicy curry...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gaaaaaaaahhhh~~!!
I-It's so spiiiiicy~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Kh, damn it... tears are coming to my eyes...!
Can I really finish all of this, me...!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is... milk!
Of course! They say milk works way better
than water against spicy food!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You saved my skin, Trainer!
With this, my engine won't overheat...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...WOOOOOHHH!!
Full throttle! I'm gonna devour the competition!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so... despite sweating bullets, Vodka somehow managed to finish every last bite.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Phew... My mouth's still on fire, but whatever,
I've officially joined the clean plate club!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Well, of course... that was all thanks
to the awesome support from my partner!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: If you ever find yourself in a pinch from now on... I'll swoop in and support you coolly, just like that!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? Sp...
I-It's... so spiiiicyyyy!?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... M-My mouth's still
burning like crazy...!
I-I went through pure hell...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't even make it halfway in the end...
Dammit... That's so uncool.
choice_data_list: Still, you did a great job.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks. But you know,
bailing just because 'it's too hard!'
is totally uncool, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... If I ever get another chance to try it,
I'm definitely taking you down!
Ultra-Spicy Tartarus Lava Curry!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... You're totally right.
Being stubborn about weird stuff is actually pretty lame.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...N-No, it ain't like I'm dying to eat that pudding or anything.
It's just that I haven't had sweets lately, ya know?"

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Vodka-chan.
What are you having to eat today?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me...
Could I get that thing
near the bottom of the menu?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text: Hm? Which one do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "So, u-um...! Urgh...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh! Guhhhh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, for me!!
One Angel Lovely☆Heart...
Squishy-Squishy... Pudding! Please!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~, that was embarrassing!
Jeez... Scarlet wasn't watching
from somewhere, was she...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Geez, after finally getting these tickets...
I never expected things to turn out like this...
choice_data_list: But it was delicious, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Well, yeah. I guess it's, y'know...
good enough to live up to that grandiose name...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...It was pretty damn good, wasn't it?
